info.name: NGINX njs Scripting Connections HTTP Upstreams API
NGINX Return Status of All HTTP Upstream Server Groups

params.name: fields
params.description: Limits which fields of upstream server groups will be output. If the “<literal>fields</literal>” value is empty, only names of upstreams will be output.

items.docs: Returns status of each HTTP upstream server group and its servers.

info.name: NGINX Return Status of an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of an HTTP upstream server group.

params.name: fields
params.description: Limits which fields of the upstream server group will be output.

items.docs: Returns status of a particular HTTP upstream server group and its servers.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics of an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of an HTTP upstream server group.

items.docs: Resets the statistics for each upstream server in an upstream server group and queue statistics.

info.name: NGINX Return Configuration of All Servers in an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of an upstream server group.

items.docs: Returns configuration of each server in a particular HTTP upstream server group.

info.name: NGINX Add a Server to an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of an upstream server group.

items.docs: Adds a new server to an HTTP upstream server group. Server parameters are specified in the JSON format.

info.name: NGINX Return Configuration of a Server in an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of the upstream server group.

items.docs: Returns configuration of a particular server in the HTTP upstream server group.

info.name: NGINX Modify a Server in an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of the upstream server group.

items.docs: Modifies settings of a particular server in an HTTP upstream server group. Server parameters are specified in the JSON format.

info.name: NGINX Remove a Server from an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of the upstream server group.

items.docs: Removes a server from an HTTP upstream server group.
